dct_description_sm: To review the Integrated Regional Impact Study approach to science-policy interaction used in Nunavik and Nunatsiavut to assess the factors influencing this model of science-policy connection and the lessons learned in this case.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Knowledge transfer
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Policy
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Decision makers
dct_title_s: Case Study: ArcticNet IRIS as a mechanism for science-policy interaction
